title: Caves running under the Giza plateau
summary: Luke Caverns tells of Caves running under the Giza plateau, about an unknown time at Giza plateau, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: This story is about caves under the Giza plateau, the area in Egypt where the great pyramids and the Sphinx stand. A researcher named Luke Caverns says on Jesse Michels' podcast that people digging there hit a cavern, and that through cracks in its walls there are caves running under the whole plateau. Another researcher, Geoffrey Drumm, says on the same show that it is known for sure that there are caves and tunnels under Giza, without telling how they were reached. If true, there would be a whole hidden underground world beneath the pyramids.
